subtitle: Anti-pilgrimage role-playing board game
designer: Journey to the West reality-TV project team
core_mechanism: Players role-play Tathāgata / Guanyin / Laojun / the Jade Emperor · jointly investing in the 'Journey to the West' reality-TV project · generating ratings (merit points) by staging hardships · settling the return on investment at Spirit Mountain
victory_condition: Highest merit wins at the end of the game · or, if the project fails, the one with the fewest losses wins

players.title: Chief Project Designer
players.special_ability: May intervene forcibly once · replace any hardship with 'Five Elements Mountain Crash' · at very low cost
players.winning_strategy: Play a 'rigged hardship card' at key moments, e.g. the Great Peng Golden-Winged Roc
players.weakness: Cannot intervene directly in the mortal world · must act through a bodhisattva

players.title: Project Executor
players.special_ability: May covertly protect the team · 500 merit may be spent per hardship to lower the difficulty
players.winning_strategy: Protect the team while it forms early on · later obtain the 'Headband Curse' item
players.weakness: Small merit reserve · every spend must be counted

players.title: Prop Supplier
players.special_ability: May lend treasures to demons (Diamond Snare, Purple-Gold Gourd and the like) · earning ad-slot exposure
players.winning_strategy: Earn ad fees by renting out treasures · the Green Ox Demon is the showcase ad slot for the Diamond Snare
players.weakness: Lent-out treasures may be misused by demons · harming the Heavenly Court's reputation

players.title: Heavenly Court CEO
players.special_ability: May deploy heavenly troops and generals · but each deployment costs much merit
players.winning_strategy: Maintain the Heavenly Court's order · lose the least when the project fails
players.weakness: Heavenly troops have limited combat power · useless against top-tier demons

actions: Choose which hardship cards to play
game_phases.goal: Complete the formation of the pilgrimage team · establish the basic rules

actions: Settle the ratings of each hardship
game_phases.goal: Gain merit through hardships while keeping the project running

hardship_cards.name: Azure Ox Spirit
hardship_cards.type: Mount Descended to Earth · Ad Slot

design_eggs: The Great Peng Golden-Winged Roc is the Tathāgata side's 'rigged hardship card' · very cheap to play, extremely high return
The Green Ox Demon is Laojun's showcase ad slot for the Diamond Snare
Guanyin's Headband Curse is designed specifically to check Wukong · once obtained it greatly lowers the project's risk
The Jade Emperor's heavenly troops are useless against top-tier demons · the biggest weakness
The Tathāgata's 'Five Elements Mountain Crash' is the ultimate insurance · usable only once, at a critical moment

scoring.Project Success Rate: 60% · on success all players receive base merit
scoring.Hardship Ratings: Each hardship yields ratings by difficulty · the harder it is, the greater the return
scoring.Ad-Slot Exposure: Playing hardship cards with ad slots earns advertising fees
scoring.Return on Investment: Final merit / initial investment · highest wins
